en: Add a new product with no internet, and sell it straight away
New products are sent by themselves when the internet is back
If the shop already has the product, choose to use it or rename yours
sw: Ongeza bidhaa mpya bila intaneti, na uiuze papo hapo
Bidhaa mpya hutumwa zenyewe intaneti ikirudi
Duka likiwa tayari na bidhaa hiyo, chagua kuitumia au badilisha jina la yako
